# Rokib Al Dhin Raadh

Independent AI Researcher from Dhaka, Bangladesh. I build interpretable, logic-driven AI frameworks that challenge the black-box paradigm.

## Key Projects
- **ORMAS (Objective-driven Resilient Multi-Agent System):** A novel architecture resolving the ISS convergence trap. Uses Constructor Injection and Atomic Rollback to allow autonomous agents to learn safely in adversarial environments without catastrophic breakdown.
- **OXIMO:** A Cognitive Multi-Agent OS featuring a deterministic 7-stage pipeline. Built for production-grade, highly reliable AI task execution.

## The Journey
- Self-taught programmer from age 12.
- By 15, sold a stock market algorithm that funded my compute setup (RTX 4090).
- At 17, launched Black Bloxie LTD as a lab-rat test for OXIMO in the wild.
- Currently pursuing fellowship/institutional support to scale Transformer experiments and frontier model access.
